name: Flowers for Show
source:
You’ve lived your whole life happy and ignorant, abiding by your family’s strict rules while ignoring all else. But what happens when you can no longer deny the existence of the sinister that lurks beneath your home’s flowery exterior?

“Something is here…”

A short, atmospheric visual novel set in your childhood home. 

[From [url=https://tempuri.itch.io/flowers-for-show]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你一生都过得幸福而懵懂，遵守着家中严格的规矩，对其他一切视而不见。可当你再也无法否认，家中繁花般美好的表象之下潜藏着邪恶时，又会发生什么？

“有什么东西在这里……”

一部以你童年故居为舞台、注重氛围营造的短篇视觉小说。

[摘自[url=https://tempuri.itch.io/flowers-for-show]itch.io[/url]]
